failure_summary.description: Returned a related entity or property instead of the requested answer slot, including works instead of an actor, a truth value instead of the identified person, and an already-named participant instead of the other actor.

Identified the right referent but used the wrong lexical granularity or name form: an expanded term instead of the headword, and a surname instead of the supported conventional full name with honorific.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already directly addresses these failures: it instructs the agent to infer the answer slot, distinguish a performer from works, avoid True/False for factual clues, check the candidate's type, and preserve a supported honorific. The dominant pattern is failure to follow those rules, so additional wording would duplicate existing guidance.
